title: Independent audit of PLAY-01 durable synthetic match commands and Director-authorized integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commit 34b609b (PLAY-01, CHG-20261013-004/005) against ADR0013, blueprint §7.1, the backlog acceptance and the earlier audit findings. Reviewed the shared 13-move policy and its server/Lab guards (forbidden check after ended/revision checks, before mutation, never journaled), the replay refactor and private persistence module (closed records, separate digest domain, canonical bytes, match-bound RNG context, full re-execution comparison, seed zeroing), the bounded worker executor (limits, environment filtering, output draining, termination ownership, queue expiry, close), the service order (receipt, participant, pins, stale, forbidden, outside-transaction candidate, CAS), the repository (FOR UPDATE row lock, receipt re-check under the lock, version/checkpoint-digest fence, atomic receipt/journal/outbox, rollback), additive migrations 0002/0003, the evidence-recorder flush/fsync change (clock guard unchanged), the single-fingerprint documentation load, the pinned Bun cache and test-file scheduling (all tests retained). Requirement/backlog edits add evidence links only; 548 dispositions unchanged. Verdict: PLAY-01 acceptance met; the manual/debug-move finding from the RULE-04 and refresh audits is closed for server and Lab.

Independent runs RUN-20261013-118..126 all passed at Codex's final fingerprint 2c343976 with exact timing and 0 redactions: full verify:foundation (286 project checks = 262 Node + 24 Python, 406 upstream passes/1 inherited skip, 2 injection tests); auditor policy probe (25-move registry, 13 allowlisted, 176 refusals across server, Lab qualification, Lab advanced-sandbox and the private wrapper for both players, identity binds policy bytes, 12 re-digested checkpoint forgeries refused, 6 replays verified/6 tampers refused); Codex's real PostgreSQL suite (3 storage + 10 service cases incl. both SIGKILL boundaries); auditor live service probe (six-way terminal race commits once with one terminal event, six-way duplicate storm, 28 forbidden receipts, 8 no-write refusals, storage-writer forgeries fail closed, lost-ack/isolation/clock-floor/create checks, privacy scan of 74 rows); migration history and role privileges on local and test; five DB regressions and eight identities; boundary/bundle probe (280 browser and 80 server-to-kernel imports refused, no server-only markers in bundles, kernel unchanged); pinned Chromium install into the recreated workspace container; Chromium 6 web scenarios and 2 Lab workers. RUN-20261013-127 docs:check covers this record.

Follow-ups recorded, none blocking integration: (1) Lab advanced-sandbox now refuses the raw manual moves; Sandbox manipulation requirements R04.009-R04.017 remain in the Director's scope and need dedicated reward-isolated operations (ADR0013 anticipates this). (2) Restore re-executes the full private transcript within a 5 s/64 MiB worker for every command; realistic-length real-card matches are unmeasured and must be timed before PLAY-03/OPS-01. (3) Private checkpoints in match.matches contain live seeds, readable only by the match role; database backups/exports are secret material (OPS-01, D10). (4) Stale/rejected receipts are final per command ID; the PLAY-03 client protocol must issue new IDs. (5) Correction: the refresh audit's RUN055 '895,847 bytes' counted UTF-16 characters; the kernel file is 895,853 bytes and unchanged by PLAY-01.

Appended a dated independent-audit section to docs/validation/play-01.md and dated audit notes to ADR0013, the PLAY-01 plan, the match-commands runbook and (correction) the upstream refresh review; added the audit sentence to AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md; updated HANDOFF, the F-MATCH-COMMANDS feature entry/evidence, FEATURES.md and the PLAY-01 backlog evidence link. Codex text, records and run logs are unchanged.

Local isolated CI was not rerun: the Windows host had a low-memory crash during PLAY-01 and two later CI attempts were cancelled for memory pressure (interruption record), and the unchanged clock guard rejected Codex's otherwise complete RUN113. Under the Director's leave-environment decision no clock, threshold or memory setting was changed. Hosted Foundation qualification, which runs the same ci-local.py pipeline including the new live-match stage, is dispatched on the published audit branch before main is fast-forwarded and observed again on main; both are recorded in a later change.
